newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha flat, quiet, buying muted.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha flat, quiet, buying muted.

text.p: NWE naphtha prices were little changed on Tuesday and business on the physical market was relatively quiet.
An end user bought a small 5,000 tonne piece on the barge market at round the low of published quotes on a fob ARA basis.
No fresh avails were seen on the market.

Dealers said they thought most of the term contract negotiations between KPC and Asian players had ended and a number of annual contracts had been signed at around the mean of Middle Eastern quotes +$18.00.
